# HWZIP 2.4 legacy ZIP codecs

Hans Wennborg's public-domain implementation of PKZIP methods 1–6 (Shrink, Reduce, Implode), from
https://www.hanshq.net/files/hwzip/hwzip-2.4.zip (2024-09-01).

Source archive SHA-256: `5a3fecfaf362972673d40ca0611622cfa94170c70029fbd8c9aa64a9e7d387ac`.
Codec/primitive files are copied unchanged; tables.c was generated by the
archive's generate_tables.c using its documented build command. The files include the encoder routines,
which make their original build dependencies self-contained. Only the decoder
is used by 2ine's bounded media adapter. The upstream public-domain dedication
and full Unlicense text are in LICENSE. This is ZIP Implode, distinct from
PKWARE DCL Implode. No OS/2 distribution files are included here.

Generated tables can be reproduced from the original archive with
`cc generate_tables.c -o generate_tables && ./generate_tables > tables.c`.
